title: Startup Research OS domain vocabulary
description: GENERATED FILE. Source of truth: packages/contracts/schema/domain.v1.json. Regenerate with python packages/contracts/tools/generate.py.

ClaimType.description: How an analytical statement is supported. Never conflated in any output.

Confidence.description: How much the system trusts a value or interpretation. Presented as a percentage.

DemandSignalFamily.description: Closed. Signal TYPES within a family are a registry, not an enum.

EvidenceId.description: An evidence record with mandatory provenance.

EvidenceLevel.description: 0 Hypothesis, 1 Weak, 2 Repeated, 3 Multi-source, 4 Market evidence, 5 Direct validation. Never rescaled, never averaged into a score.

Independence.description: Estimated independence from other evidence. The threshold gating evidence level 3 is A-04 and remains UNDEFINED.

LlmTier.description: Logical tier. Business services request a tier, never a provider or model name.

MarketScopeType.description: Geographic scope discriminator. Geographic axis only; segment scoping is A-12 and is NOT modelled.

OpportunityId.description: A domain hypothesis. Not owned by the session that found it. Ontology V2 §12.

PersonalDataRisk.description: How likely the source is to carry personal data. A RISK CLASSIFICATION, not a legal ruling: it records what must be handled carefully and what still needs jurisdiction-specific review. GDPR analysis is separate and remains a human decision.

PolicyAssessment.description: The verdict for ONE activity. Activities are assessed separately because their conditions differ: a source may permit automated API access and forbid commercial use. A single boolean called `allowed` would erase exactly that difference.

PolicyEvidenceType.description: What kind of document supports an assessment. Ordered by the evidence hierarchy: official operator documentation outranks anything else, and nothing below OFFICIAL_* may support an APPROVED state on its own.

Probability.description: Likelihood of an event or outcome.

RegistryRef.description: A reference into an extensible registry. Persists the stable id, never the display name.

RegistryStatus.description: Deprecation, never deletion. A deprecated entry stops being offered for new classification but keeps resolving for historical records.

ResearchContext.description: Value object, not an entity. Serialized as an immutable snapshot on a ResearchSession. Ontology V2 §11.3.

ResearchProjectId.description: Persistent workspace-scoped research objective. Ontology V2 §11.2.

ResearchSessionId.description: The only persisted execution entity. Ontology V2 §11.4. Replaces the retired 'run_id'.

ResearchSessionStatus.description: Session lifecycle. Budget exhaustion is COMPLETED with reduced Research Completeness, never a status. A session that finds nothing is COMPLETED, not FAILED.

Score.description: An assessed magnitude. NOT interchangeable with Confidence.

ScoreFamily.description: The five families. Never collapsed into a single number, not in an API, a sort key or a badge.

SourceAccessMethod.description: HOW access is technically performed. It says nothing about whether access is PERMITTED: permission is a separate dimension carried by the policy review. BROWSER_AUTOMATION being available never implies it is allowed.

SourceAcquisitionCost.description: The shape of what access costs, not an amount. Concrete prices are versioned configuration because operators change them; a price compiled in here would be wrong within months and would look authoritative.

SourceApprovalState.description: Where a source stands in the governance gate. Closed: collector eligibility branches exhaustively on it, and an unhandled value would mean a source of unknown standing being treated as usable. Public visibility never produces APPROVED on its own.

SourceId.description: A registered external source. Global, not tenant-scoped. Registry contents are D-07, still open.

SourceLifecycle.description: Whether the source itself still exists as a target. Separate from approval: a deprecated source may have been approved, and an active source may never have been reviewed.

UserId.description: A principal. Not a tenant. See ADR-005.

WorkspaceId.description: The tenant boundary. Required on every tenant-scoped contract.
